error.CATALOG_SUGGESTION_STALE: That suggestion is no longer open (decided, dismissed, superseded, expired, its signer revoked, or it names another revision). Nothing was changed; see `deckent agents suggestions`.
error.CATALOG_SUGGESTION_SHADOW: That suggestion was recorded in shadow mode: it is evidence only and offers no card. Nothing was changed.
error.CATALOG_DRAFT_UNAVAILABLE: No draft can be offered: fewer of its lessons are readable for you than the rule needs, or none fits the skill size. Nothing was changed.
error.CATALOG_DRAFT_CHANGED: The draft changed after the card was shown (the lessons you may read, or the template). Nothing was changed; open the card again.
agentsevo.help:
deckent agents suggestions [list | show <suggestion-id>] [--scope <id>] [--json]
  Lists the catalog's sealed suggestions (promote, redesign, revise, a new agent, a new skill) or shows one with the numbers it was sealed with. A suggestion changes nothing by itself.
deckent agents promote|demote|restore|retire <agent-id> --work-class <id> [--suggestion <id>] [--scope <id>]
  One card for one agent's current revision in one work class. A promoted agent may run on low-risk work without a Run card; a promotion turns the work class's previous promoted agent into a candidate. The card decides the open suggestion for it, if any.
deckent agents dismiss <suggestion-id> [--scope <id>]
  Dismisses an open suggestion; the same agent and kind come back only after new work.
deckent agents standing reset --work-class <id> [--scope <id>]
  Moves every promoted or narrowed agent of the work class back to candidate (one card).
deckent agents define --from-suggestion <id> --id <agent-id> | define-skill --from-suggestion <id> --id <skill-id> [--scope <id>]
  Defines from a suggestion's draft, rendered now from what you may read; a skill drafted from lessons is AI output.
Every card runs only on your own terminal; AI tools, pipes and --json are refused. Numbers are associations, not causes, and acceptance rates, not accuracy.
agentsevo.labels: association, not causation · acceptance rate, not accuracy
agentsevo.rule.calibrated: calibrated (agreed with your decisions; acceptance rate, not accuracy)
agentsevo.show.head: Suggestion {id} · {kind} · {state}
agentsevo.show.shadow: Recorded in shadow mode: evidence only, no card and no narrowing.
agentsevo.show.weakFilter: Spread over at least two models or two periods: a weak filter only.
agentsevo.show.proposeRevise: Proposes: revise the agent (define a new revision)
agentsevo.show.proposeAgentDraft: Proposes: a new agent for this work class (draft {template}, rendered on the card)
agentsevo.show.proposeSkillDraft: Proposes: a new skill from verified lessons (draft {template}, rendered on the card) · lessons you may read {shown}, hidden from you {withheld}
agentsevo.card.noSuggestion: No sealed suggestion backs this card. Live numbers: deckent agents stats {id}
agentsevo.card.aiAuthor: This revision was written by an AI ({author}); you decide its standing.
agentsevo.card.effect.promote: The system may then pick it without a Run card on low-risk work of this class; the class's current promoted agent becomes a candidate. It grants no authority and names no model.
agentsevo.card.effect.demote: It stays selectable only on a Run card, and only while no other agent is promoted. Runs already admitted keep their agent.
agentsevo.card.effect.restore: It becomes a candidate again: selectable only on a Run card. A new suggestion for it needs new work.
agentsevo.card.effect.retire: This revision is never selected again for this class; final for the revision. Runs already admitted keep their agent.
agentsevo.card.dismiss.title: Dismiss suggestion
agentsevo.card.dismiss.body: Changes no standing. The same agent and kind are suggested again only after new work.
agentsevo.card.reset.title: Reset work class {workClass}
agentsevo.card.reset.body: Every agent above goes back to candidate (selectable only on a Run card). Retired revisions stay retired; Runs already admitted keep their agent.
agentsevo.reset.none: No promoted or narrowed agent in work class {workClass}; nothing to reset.
agentsevo.done.reset: {count} agent(s) of work class {workClass} are candidates again.
agentsevo.draft.lessons: From {count} lesson(s) you may read; {omitted} did not fit, {withheld} hidden from you.
agentsevo.draft.aiDerived: Derived from AI output: these lessons started as worker claims. Read before you apply.
agentsevo.draft.body: Rendered now from suggestion {suggestion}; nothing of this text was stored before. Applying defines it as yours and decides the suggestion.
agentsevo.view.aiNoCarry: AI author: promotion not carried over (an AI-written revision always starts as a candidate).
agentsevo.revoked.title: Revoked key: {count} promotion(s) still in effect
agentsevo.revoked.body: They stay selectable without a Run card until a person demotes them (your choice when the key was set up). Apply demotes them all now, in one step.
agentsevo.revoked.kept: {count} promotion(s) signed by the revoked key stay in effect; demote them any time: deckent agents demote <agent-id> --work-class <id>
agentsevo.revoked.done: {count} promotion(s) signed by the revoked key demoted to candidate.
agentsevo.monitor.signerRevoked: Signer revoked: {count} promotion(s) it signed still in effect
agentsevo.monitor.unsigned: Catalog aggregator has no signing key: it writes nothing
agentsevo.monitor.unsignedAction: To enrol: deckent agents enrol-signer --scope {scope} --principal {principal} --label aggregator
agentsevo.monitor.registry: Catalog evolution registry unavailable: no suggestion and no narrowing (Runs unaffected)
mcp.tool.listAgentSuggestions: List the catalog's sealed suggestions (promote, redesign, revise, new agent, new skill) with the numbers they were sealed with: refs, digests and counts only; lessons you may not read are only counted. Associations, not causes (read-only).
mcp.tool.inspectAgentSuggestion: Show one sealed suggestion, its state history and the standing it is about: refs, digests and counts only, never draft or lesson text (read-only).
mcp.tool.signedDefineAgent: Define or revise an agent as this AI actor: signed with its own enrolled key and allowed only by a policy grant (none by default); verified again at commit. An AI-written revision always starts as a candidate.
mcp.tool.signedDefineSkill: Define or revise a local skill as this AI actor: signed with its own enrolled key and allowed only by a policy grant (none by default); verified again at commit.
mcp.tool.signedImportSkill: Import a pinned skill signed by an import key of the scope, as this AI actor: signed with its own enrolled key and allowed only by a policy grant (none by default).
mcp.tool.signedChangeStanding: Promote, demote, restore or retire one agent revision for one work class as this AI actor: signed with its own key and allowed only by a grant naming that work class; never on a revision it wrote or a suggestion it produced.
mcp.tool.signedDismissSuggestion: Dismiss one open live suggestion as this AI actor: signed with its own key and allowed only by a grant naming its work class; changes no standing.
agentsevo.help.action.suggestions: list or show the catalog's sealed suggestions
agentsevo.help.action.promote: promote an agent in one work class (a person's card)
agentsevo.help.action.demote: demote a promoted agent to candidate (a person's card)
agentsevo.help.action.restore: restore a narrowed agent to candidate (a person's card)
agentsevo.help.action.retire: retire an agent revision in one work class (a person's card)
agentsevo.help.action.dismiss: dismiss an open suggestion (a person's card)
agentsevo.help.action.standing: reset a work class: all its agents back to candidate (a person's card)
agentsevo.monitor.unsignedUnknownAction: Inspect signer identities: deckent agents signers
agentsevo.card.zeroEvidence: Warning: no measured work backs this promotion (no sealed suggestion from accepted tasks). It is your own judgement; the agent becomes the one picked for this WorkClass.
